outfit: a charcoal-black sleeveless hoodie with the hood down, a thick silver chain, black fingerless gloves

shamz.s1_stop: He holds one flat palm up toward the camera like a stop sign, frowning, mouth open saying 'stop'. Background: an original small-town Florida bank branch at dusk, beige stucco, palm trees, a modest glass door, warm street light, haze.
shamz.s3_smirk: He gives a sly sideways smirk and points at the camera, relaxed. Background: an original Ocean Beach street at sunset, pastel art-deco buildings, palm trees, a parked armored cash van in the distance, pink and orange sky.
shamz.s2_grin: He grins with wide excited eyes, rubbing his gloved hands together. Background: inside an enormous original marble bank lobby at night, a massive round steel vault door glowing with warm light behind him, brass details, dust in the light.

scenes.b_vault: The interior of a giant round bank vault, its huge circular steel door wide open, shelves of stacked cash bricks and gold bars glowing under warm lights, polished floor, dramatic perspective.
scenes.b_van: A boxy steel-grey armored cash-in-transit truck with no badges, no logos and no lettering, parked at the curb outside a grand art-deco bank at golden hour in a Florida city, two guard silhouettes, palm trees, long shadows.
